title: Week 1 review
topic: Security + Management & Governance — full Week 1 recap
format: 25 timed scenario questions (aim for ~40 min, ~96 sec each). Answer without night-6-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×7 B×6 C×6 D×6 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: An IAM administrator has AdministratorAccess but cannot create an EC2 instance. The organization uses AWS Organizations. What is the most likely cause?

options.A: A Service Control Policy (SCP) denies ec2:RunInstances in the account
options.B: The IAM user lacks an MFA device attached to the console login profile
options.C: CloudTrail is not enabled so EC2 API calls are rejected by the control plane
options.D: The VPC has no internet gateway, so RunInstances is denied by IAM

questions.question: Account A needs to share a private subnet with Account B for a Transit Gateway attachment. Which service enables cross-account subnet sharing?

options.A: AWS IAM Identity Center — workforce SSO, not cross-account resource sharing
options.B: AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) — share subnets and TGW across accounts
options.C: AWS Organizations consolidated billing — cost rollup without resource share
options.D: AWS Config aggregator — multi-account compliance view, not subnet sharing

questions.question: A company wants single sign-on for employees to access 15 AWS accounts and Salesforce. Which service is purpose-built for this?

options.A: Amazon Cognito user pools — customer app auth, not workforce multi-account SSO
options.B: AWS Resource Access Manager — shares AWS resources, not employee SSO portals
options.C: AWS IAM Identity Center — workforce SSO to AWS accounts and SaaS apps
options.D: AWS Directory Service Simple AD — directory only, not multi-account SSO hub

questions.question: An ECS Fargate task fails with CannotPullContainerError. The task role has AmazonS3FullAccess. What should you fix first?

options.A: Add ECR pull permissions to the task role used by application code at runtime
options.B: Enable GuardDuty Malware Protection on the cluster before retrying the task
options.C: Attach a WAF Web ACL to the task ENI to allow ECR registry HTTPS traffic
options.D: Add ECR and CloudWatch Logs permissions to the task execution role

questions.question: Traffic is allowed inbound on port 443 in a security group but blocked by the subnet NACL. After the connection is established, return traffic fails. Why?

options.A: NACLs are stateless and must allow ephemeral return ports explicitly
options.B: Security groups are stateless while NACLs automatically track return flows
options.C: CloudFront edge caches the NACL denial and replays it on return packets
options.D: KMS key policy blocks the TLS handshake after the TCP connection opens

questions.question: Account B must decrypt objects encrypted with Account A's KMS CMK. Which combination is required?

options.A: IAM policy on Account B user only — key policy is never evaluated cross-account
options.B: KMS key policy on the CMK granting Account B plus IAM on Account B's principal
options.C: S3 bucket policy only — KMS permissions are not required for SSE-KMS reads
options.D: Secrets Manager rotation Lambda — automatically grants cross-account decrypt

questions.question: You enable SSE-KMS on a high-traffic S3 bucket and costs spike from KMS API calls. Which feature reduces KMS request charges?

options.A: S3 Transfer Acceleration — speeds uploads via edge, does not cut KMS API cost
options.B: CloudFront OAC — private origin access, does not reduce per-object KMS calls
options.C: S3 Bucket Key — bucket-level key reduces KMS API requests for SSE-KMS objects
options.D: Macie classification jobs — discover PII, unrelated to KMS request pricing

questions.question: A developer asks where to store database passwords with automatic rotation and Lambda integration. What do you recommend?

options.A: AWS Secrets Manager — stores credentials with optional automatic rotation hooks
options.B: AWS KMS alone — manages encryption keys, not application password values
options.C: SSM Parameter Store String — config storage without native secret rotation
options.D: CloudTrail log files — audit history only, never a secrets store for apps

questions.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes KMS and Secrets Manager?

options.A: KMS stores application secrets; Secrets Manager stores encryption key material
options.B: Both services are interchangeable for password storage and key management
options.C: Secrets Manager replaces IAM policies for authorizing API access to resources
options.D: KMS manages encryption keys; Secrets Manager stores and rotates secret values

questions.question: You need a free TLS certificate for a CloudFront distribution. In which Region must you request the ACM certificate?

options.A: Same Region as the origin S3 bucket — ACM follows the origin Region always
options.B: us-east-1 (N. Virginia) only — required for certificates used with CloudFront
options.C: eu-west-1 for global edge — CloudFront prefers Ireland for ACM issuance
options.D: Any Region — ACM certificates for CloudFront are global and Region-agnostic

questions.question: You attach a WAF Web ACL to an Application Load Balancer in eu-west-1. What WAF scope must the Web ACL use?

options.A: CLOUDFRONT — only valid for distributions created in us-east-1
options.B: GLOBAL — Shield Advanced scope that replaces WAF for all ALB listeners
options.C: REGIONAL — Web ACL created in the same Region as the ALB resource
options.D: EDGE — Lambda@Edge scope used when attaching WAF to ALB target groups

questions.question: SQL injection probes hit your CloudFront distribution. Shield Standard is already active. What additional service blocks L7 application attacks?

options.A: AWS WAF with managed rule groups — inspects HTTP for SQLi/XSS at the edge
options.B: AWS Network Firewall — VPC east-west filtering, not CloudFront L7 inspection
options.C: Security groups on CloudFront — CloudFront does not use VPC security groups
options.D: AWS Config managed rules — compliance evaluation, not live HTTP attack blocking

questions.question: A security architect needs stateful inspection of east-west traffic between subnets in the same VPC. Which service fits?

options.A: AWS WAF on CloudFront — HTTP edge filtering, not VPC subnet-to-subnet traffic
options.B: AWS Shield Advanced only — DDoS protection, not east-west traffic inspection
options.C: IAM permission boundary — limits max permissions, not network packet filtering
options.D: AWS Network Firewall in the VPC — stateful inspection between subnets

questions.question: An organization with 50 accounts wants to deploy a baseline WAF rule set to all CloudFront distributions automatically. Which service?

options.A: Amazon GuardDuty — threat detection findings, not org-wide WAF rule deployment
options.B: AWS Security Hub — aggregates findings, does not push WAF policies to accounts
options.C: AWS Firewall Manager — centrally deploys WAF policies across Organizations
options.D: VPC network ACL — subnet filtering only, cannot protect CloudFront distributions

questions.question: Which service answers: 'Which IAM user called DeleteBucket yesterday at 3 PM?'

options.A: AWS Config — configuration history and compliance, not a searchable API who/when log
options.B: AWS CloudTrail — API audit log with principal, time, and request details
options.C: Amazon GuardDuty — threat findings, not a full chronological API audit trail
options.D: AWS Trusted Advisor — best-practice checks, not per-API-call accountability

questions.question: An auditor needs cryptographic proof that CloudTrail logs were not modified after S3 delivery. Which feature?

options.A: Log file validation — digest hashes prove delivered CloudTrail logs were not altered
options.B: Data event logging — records object-level API calls, not log-file integrity proof
options.C: CloudTrail Insights — unusual activity detection, not cryptographic tamper evidence
options.D: Multi-Region trail only — expands coverage without proving log file integrity

questions.question: You need continuous monitoring of whether any S3 bucket currently allows public read. Best approach?

options.A: Enable GuardDuty S3 Protection only — threat detection, not public-read compliance
options.B: CloudTrail management events — show past changes, not continuous current state
options.C: CloudWatch metric alarm alone — needs a custom metric; not a managed public-read rule
options.D: AWS Config managed rule S3_BUCKET_PUBLIC_READ_PROHIBITED — continuous evaluation

questions.question: An EC2 instance is mining cryptocurrency and communicating with a known malicious IP. Which service generates this finding?

options.A: AWS Config — configuration compliance rules, not crypto-mining threat detection
options.B: Amazon GuardDuty — ML threat detection from CloudTrail, VPC Flow, and DNS logs
options.C: IAM Access Analyzer — external access paths on policies, not malware C2 findings
options.D: AWS Audit Manager — evidence collection for audits, not live threat findings

questions.question: An S3 bucket policy grants s3:GetObject to Principal '*'. Which tool identifies external access paths?

options.A: AWS Config compliance dashboard — rule status, not a map of external principals
options.B: Amazon Macie — discovers sensitive data in S3, not external access path analysis
options.C: IAM Access Analyzer — evaluates resource policies for external/cross-account access
options.D: AWS Control Tower — landing zone guardrails, not per-bucket external access findings

questions.question: Developers need shell access to private EC2 instances without opening SSH port 22 to the internet. Recommended approach?

options.A: AWS Systems Manager Session Manager — shell via SSM agent without inbound SSH
options.B: Bastion host in a public subnet — still requires managing SSH and bastion hardening
options.C: CloudTrail data events — audit object access, does not provide interactive shell
options.D: AWS Artifact reports — compliance documents, unrelated to instance shell access

questions.question: You must discover and classify PII in S3 buckets automatically. Which service?

options.A: AWS KMS — manages encryption keys, does not classify sensitive data in objects
options.B: AWS WAF — filters HTTP requests at the edge, not S3 object content classification
options.C: Amazon Inspector — vulnerability scanning for EC2/ECR, not S3 PII discovery
options.D: Amazon Macie — discovers and classifies sensitive data such as PII in S3

questions.question: A static website uses a public S3 bucket behind CloudFront. Config shows NON_COMPLIANT on S3_BUCKET_PUBLIC_READ_PROHIBITED but the site works. Best interpretation?

options.A: Config is broken — public buckets cannot work correctly with CloudFront origins
options.B: The bucket allows public read, failing the rule; migrate to private bucket + OAC
options.C: GuardDuty will automatically make the bucket private when it sees public GetObject
options.D: CloudTrail disables public access overnight when a Config rule is NON_COMPLIANT

questions.question: A wiki API Lambda needs Cognito client credentials. Where should secrets live with least privilege?

options.A: Hard-coded in Lambda environment variables as plaintext Cognito client secrets
options.B: CloudTrail log stream — audit storage only, never a runtime secrets source
options.C: Secrets Manager with IAM scoped to GetSecretValue and kms:Decrypt on the CMK
options.D: S3 bucket policy alone — grants object access, does not store Cognito credentials

questions.question: A multi-account landing zone with guardrails and automated account vending is required. Which service provides this?

options.A: AWS Control Tower — multi-account landing zone with guardrails and account factory
options.B: Amazon Cognito — customer identity for apps, not org landing-zone provisioning
options.C: AWS Batch — managed batch compute jobs, unrelated to account vending
options.D: AWS DataSync — data transfer between storage, not multi-account governance

questions.question: A team enabled AWS Config recording all resources and now wants to stop Config charges while keeping the account's first CloudTrail trail for audit. What should they do?

options.A: Delete the KMS CMK used by Secrets Manager — stops Config but breaks encryption
options.B: Delete all IAM users in the account — removes principals but not Config recording
options.C: Remove CloudFront distributions — cuts CDN cost, not Config configuration-item charges
options.D: Stop/delete the Config recorder, rules, and delivery channel; leave CloudTrail enabled
